items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 25 at 3:31AM EDT until October 25 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Eastern Currituck County. In
Virginia, Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM EDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Shallow flooding is possible in the most vulnerable
locations near the waterfront and shoreline.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 25 at 6:28AM EDT until October 26 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 5 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light to Virginia-
North Carolina border out 20 NM and Coastal waters from NC VA
border to Currituck Beach Light NC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
